notes.title: Update Notes For Jan 25
notes.content: To fix a strange bug where the character's speed changes too slowly, I removed the SUPER SPRINT triggered by the 'Q' key.

notes.title: Update Notes For Jan 4
notes.content:
Difficulty Adjustment Update

I’ve made some adjustments to the overall difficulty of the game based on you all feedbacks. Here are the key changes:

[olist]
 In the ‘Slide’ stage, Joe’s movement speed has been slightly reduced.
 In the ‘Teacher’ stage, Drew’s initial speed has been slightly decreased.
 The spacing between the larger kids in the ‘Teacher’ stage hallway has been increased.
 All the Obstacle's damage in the ‘Teacher’ stage has been reduced.
 Hallway doors in the ‘Teacher’ stage can now be opened immediately.
 The number of guards in the ‘Storagers’ stage has been decreased, and their bullet damage has been reduced.
 Fixed instances where character names appeared as "NPC."
 To enhance story comprehension, I’ve added more of Joe’s monologues to certain stages.
 Updated and refined some menu text for better clarity.

[/olist]
I want to sincerely thank everyone who purchased my game during the holiday season. Your support means the world to me!
